title: Modi and Nepal PM Balendra Shah flag off Ayodhya-Janakpur Saryu-Kamala Express; Delhi air stays 'poor' as CAQM sets 2027 cut target; Wellington Test ends in a draw

morning.line: It's Tuesday, and today is Guru Nanak Jayanti. Expect a misty, cool start with 'poor' air in Delhi-NCR, so keep outdoor time short and stay safe.
morning.thought: A train only needs two tracks to cross a border; people only need one shared story to cross a difference.

day.name: Guru Nanak Jayanti (Gurpurab)
day.about: Today Sikhs and many others celebrate the birth anniversary (Prakash Purab) of Guru Nanak Dev Ji, the first Sikh Guru, born in 1469 at Talwandi (now Nankana Sahib, Pakistan). It falls on Kartik Purnima. He taught equality of all people, honest work (kirat karni), sharing with others (vand chhakna) and remembering God (naam japna). The tradition of langar, a free community kitchen where everyone sits together, is linked to his teachings.

word.meaning: (noun) the state of being linked or connected, such as by roads, railways, power lines or the internet.
word.example: The new Saryu-Kamala Express improves rail connectivity between India and Nepal.

morning.task: Guru Nanak Dev Ji travelled widely on journeys called 'Udasis'. Look up one place he visited and mark it on a map. Then write two lines on what 'vand chhakna' (sharing) means in your own life.

headlines.title: PM Modi and Nepal PM Balendra Shah flag off the Saryu-Kamala Express linking Ayodhya and Janakpur Dham.
headlines.summary: On 23 November 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah held talks at Hyderabad House, New Delhi, after a ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan. They virtually flagged off the Saryu-Kamala Express, a new weekly train between Ayodhya Cantt (Uttar Pradesh) and Janakpur Dham (Nepal). The 604 km trip takes about 19 hours, and regular runs begin on 28 November. The leaders also opened a motorable bridge linking Darchula (Nepal) and Dharchula (India) and the second phase of the Motihari-Amlekhgunj petroleum pipeline, and laid foundation stones for the 669 MW Lower Arun hydropower project and a check post at Banbasa, Uttarakhand.
headlines.gk: The Saryu (Sarayu) river flows past Ayodhya, and the Kamala river flows through Nepal's Mithila region near Janakpur. The Motihari-Amlekhgunj pipeline (2019) was South Asia's first cross-border petroleum pipeline.

headlines.title: Delhi's air stays 'poor' as CAQM asks NCR states to plan a 15-20% cut in pollution for 2027.
headlines.summary: Delhi's air quality index (AQI) was 236 at 8 am on 23 November 2026, in the 'poor' band, with Sirifort the worst station at 333. The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) has told Delhi and the NCR states to prepare action plans for 2027 that cut the pollution load by at least 15%, aiming for up to 20%. For the first time, separate district-level plans are required, and officers will be named as responsible. Stage II of GRAP stays in force across Delhi-NCR, and air is expected to stay 'poor' till Wednesday.
headlines.gk: GRAP (Graded Response Action Plan) has four stages: Stage I 'poor' (AQI 201-300), II 'very poor' (301-400), III 'severe' (401-450) and IV 'severe plus' (above 450). CAQM was set up in 2021.

headlines.title: UN population report released in New Delhi finds most young people want children but worry about costs.
headlines.summary: The United Nations Population Fund (UNFPA) released its State of World Population Report 2026, titled 'Succeeding Generations: Empowering young people to chart the future', in New Delhi. It found that 70% of adults aged 18-39 see marriage as ideal and over 90% want children, but 72% say money and housing problems hold them back. For India, the report gives a total fertility rate (TFR) of 2.0, ranging from 1.0 in Sikkim to 2.7 in Bihar.
headlines.gk: Total fertility rate is the average number of children a woman is expected to have; 2.1 is called the 'replacement level'. UNFPA was set up in 1969. World Population Day is on 11 July.
headlines.source: C4S Courses (22-23 Nov current affairs, citing UNFPA)

headlines.title: Europe-Japan spacecraft BepiColombo reaches orbit around Mercury after about eight years.
headlines.summary: BepiColombo, a joint mission of the European Space Agency (ESA) and the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA), has reached orbit around Mercury after a journey of about eight years. It carries two spacecraft: ESA's Mercury Planetary Orbiter, which will study the planet's surface and inside, and JAXA's Mercury Magnetospheric Orbiter, which will study its magnetic field.
headlines.gk: Mercury is the smallest planet and the closest to the Sun; a year there lasts just 88 Earth days. The mission is named after Italian scientist Giuseppe 'Bepi' Colombo. NASA's MESSENGER orbited Mercury from 2011 to 2015.

headlines.title: Colombian teen climate activist Francisco Vera wins the International Children's Peace Prize 2026.
headlines.summary: Colombian climate activist Francisco Javier Vera Manzanares, aged 17, received the 22nd International Children's Peace Prize at the Peace Palace in The Hague. The prize was handed over by Indian Nobel laureate Kailash Satyarthi. Francisco founded 'Guardianes por la Vida' (Guardians for Life), a group that campaigns to protect the environment.
headlines.gk: The International Children's Peace Prize was started in 2005 by Marc Dullaert of the KidsRights Foundation. Kailash Satyarthi shared the 2014 Nobel Peace Prize with Malala Yousafzai, who won the children's prize in 2013.

headlines.title: India's first Test against New Zealand ends in a draw as Mitchell and Phillips bat out the last day.
headlines.summary: The first Test between India and New Zealand at the Basin Reserve, Wellington, ended in a draw on 23 November 2026. New Zealand finished on 239 for 5 in their second innings, still behind India's huge 720 for 9 declared. Daryl Mitchell (49 not out off 186 balls) and Glenn Phillips (26 not out off 126 balls) blocked India's bowlers for hours. Washington Sundar, Prasidh Krishna and Anshul Kamboj took a wicket each on the final day. Both teams get 4 World Test Championship points, and the second Test starts on 27 November at Hagley Oval, Christchurch.
headlines.gk: In the World Test Championship, a win gets 12 points, a draw 4 and a tie 6. Wellington is the capital of New Zealand.

headlines.title: Eight core industries grow a record 10.9% in October 2026.
headlines.summary: The eight core industries grew 10.9% in October 2026, up from 8.2% in September 2026 and 0.8% in October 2025. Electricity, coal, cement and iron ore led the growth, helped by a low base last year. The Index of Core Industries now uses 2022-23 as its base year.
headlines.gk: The eight core industries are coal, crude oil, natural gas, refinery products, fertilisers, steel, cement and electricity. They make up about 40% of the Index of Industrial Production (IIP); refinery products have the highest weight.
headlines.exam: Remember: Core sector growth Oct 2026 = 10.9% (record); Sept 2026 = 8.2%; Oct 2025 = 0.8%. ICI is released by the Ministry of Commerce & Industry (Office of Economic Adviser, DPIIT).

headlines.title: Unemployment rate falls to an eight-month low of 4.9% in October 2026: PLFS.
headlines.summary: The National Statistics Office's monthly Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) bulletin shows unemployment among people aged 15 and above fell to 4.9% in October 2026, from 5% in September. Female unemployment fell from 5.2% to 5%, rural unemployment was 4.2%, and urban unemployment fell from 6.9% to 6.7%. The labour force participation rate was 55.7% and the worker population ratio 53%.
headlines.gk: The PLFS is run by the National Statistics Office (NSO) under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI). It moved to monthly estimates in 2025, using the Current Weekly Status (CWS) approach.
headlines.exam: Remember: Unemployment rate Oct 2026 = 4.9% (8-month low); urban 6.7%, rural 4.2%; LFPR 55.7%, WPR 53%.

headlines.title: EPFO approves a Systematic Withdrawal Plan and eases PF withdrawal rules.
headlines.summary: At its 240th Central Board of Trustees meeting on 19 November 2026, chaired by Labour Minister Mansukh Mandaviya, EPFO approved a Systematic Withdrawal Plan so members can take their money in regular instalments instead of one lump sum. The minimum balance that must stay in the account for withdrawal falls from 25% to 10%, and the waiting period for final settlement falls from 12 months to 2 months. EPFO also plans 'EPFO 3.0' from February 2027 for paperless services and coverage of gig workers.
headlines.gk: EPFO (Employees' Provident Fund Organisation) was set up in 1952 and works under the Ministry of Labour and Employment. The Central Board of Trustees is its top decision-making body, chaired by the Labour Minister.
headlines.exam: Remember: 240th CBT meeting (19 Nov 2026) – Systematic Withdrawal Plan; minimum balance 25%→10%; final settlement wait 12→2 months; EPFO 3.0 from Feb 2027.

headlines.title: Labour Ministry launches the NCS ONE portal and an Occupational Shortage Index.
headlines.summary: Union Labour Minister Mansukh Mandaviya launched NCS ONE (National Career Service Open Network for Employment) on the first anniversary of the four labour codes coming into force (21 November 2025). The open network links jobseekers and employers with State job portals, private platforms and campuses, and offers a voice bot and chatbot. The Ministry also launched an Occupational Shortage Index (OSI) to measure gaps between the demand for and supply of workers in different jobs.
headlines.gk: The National Career Service portal was launched in 2015. The e-Shram portal (2021) has over 30 crore unorganised workers registered. 'Labour' is in the Concurrent List of the Constitution.
headlines.exam: Remember: NCS ONE = National Career Service Open Network for Employment; launched with Occupational Shortage Index (OSI) on 1st anniversary of labour codes.

headlines.title: Bank of Baroda launches 'bob Green PLUG' loans for EV charging and battery-swapping stations.
headlines.summary: Bank of Baroda has launched the 'bob Green PLUG' scheme to finance electric-vehicle charging stations and battery-swapping infrastructure. Loans range from above ₹10 lakh up to ₹5 crore, at interest of 8.15% to 9.60% a year, for up to 120 months including a moratorium of up to 12 months. MSMEs, start-ups, charging-point operators, fleet operators, fuel stations, logistics hubs and residential societies can apply. Separately, YES BANK and novio launched a dual-network credit card combining a physical Mastercard and a virtual RuPay card.
headlines.gk: Bank of Baroda is headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat, and was founded in 1908 by Maharaja Sayajirao Gaekwad III. The PM E-DRIVE scheme supports EV charging infrastructure in India.
headlines.exam: Remember: bob Green PLUG (Bank of Baroda) – EV charging/battery swapping loans, ₹10 lakh–₹5 crore, 8.15–9.60%, tenure up to 120 months.

headlines.title: ADB names Indian economist Karthik Muralidharan as its Chief Economist.
headlines.summary: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has appointed Karthik Muralidharan as its Chief Economist and Director General of the Economic Research and Development Impact Department, effective 1 July 2027. He succeeds Albert Park. Muralidharan is Tata Chancellor's Professor of Economics at the University of California, San Diego. In other appointments, L. Madhu Nag became Director General of Akashvani on 18 November, and Deepak Rajawat will be CEO of Air India Express from 1 December 2026.
headlines.gk: ADB was set up in 1966 and is headquartered in Manila, Philippines; Japan and the USA are its largest shareholders. Akashvani (All India Radio) works under Prasar Bharati.
headlines.exam: Remember: ADB Chief Economist – Karthik Muralidharan (from 1 Jul 2027, succeeds Albert Park); DG Akashvani – L. Madhu Nag; CEO Air India Express – Deepak Rajawat (1 Dec 2026).

ai.title: India AI Education Summit in Kochi holds a students' day on 'Build Your Future with AI'.
ai.summary: The India AI Education Summit 2026 is being held on 23-24 November at Taj Vivanta, Kochi, Kerala. Day 1 (23 November) was a Students' Summit with the theme 'Build Your Future with AI', including a Student AI Project Innovation Award. Day 2 (24 November) is an Educators' Summit for school and college leaders on 'Leading the Future of Education through Responsible AI', with an AI Innovation Award for Schools. It is organised by ISE (International Skills and Education) with the Kerala CBSE School Managements Association, and CCE Finland as knowledge partner.
ai.gk: Responsible AI means using AI in ways that are fair, safe, private and transparent. CBSE has offered Artificial Intelligence as a skill subject in schools since 2019.

quiz.q: In which city is the India AI Education Summit 2026 being held on 23-24 November?
quiz.explain: The summit is at Taj Vivanta, Kochi, Kerala.

ai.title: Asian stock markets fall on fears that the AI boom may be a 'bubble'.
ai.summary: On 23 November 2026, share prices in Asia fell on worries that the artificial intelligence boom is losing steam. South Korea's Kospi index dropped as much as 5.8% and closed 3.3% lower, with chipmakers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix falling. This followed big falls in the US on Friday, when the Nasdaq dropped 5.3%. Investors doubt whether tech companies can keep spending so much on AI; research firm Gartner expects global AI investment of US$ 2.7 trillion this year.
ai.gk: A 'bubble' is when prices rise far above an asset's real value and then fall sharply, like the dot-com bubble of 2000. Kospi is South Korea's main stock index; India's are the Sensex and Nifty.

quiz.q: Which country's main stock index, the Kospi, fell sharply on AI bubble fears?
quiz.explain: The Kospi is South Korea's stock index; it closed 3.3% lower on 23 November.

ai.title: AI risks and RBI checks spark a rush to hire cybersecurity and AI leaders in banks.
ai.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is checking during routine audits whether regulated entities, including payment aggregators, have a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). It has also asked banks, small finance banks and NBFCs to tighten API controls, third-party system safeguards and fund-transfer monitoring. State Bank of India has invited applications for six senior AI, analytics, governance and architecture posts, with pay of up to ₹1.6 crore a year. Industry says there is a shortage of CISO talent, especially for smaller firms.
ai.gk: CISO = Chief Information Security Officer. CERT-In (under MeitY) is India's nodal agency for cyber incidents. The RBI was set up on 1 April 1935.
ai.exam: Remember: RBI auditing for CISOs at regulated entities (incl. payment aggregators); SBI hiring 6 senior AI/analytics posts, pay up to ₹1.6 crore.

quiz.q: In banking cybersecurity, what does CISO stand for?
quiz.explain: A CISO is a Chief Information Security Officer; RBI is checking that regulated entities have one.

ai.title: Nvidia's board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, 11 days after he resigned.
ai.summary: On 23 November 2026, the board of AI chipmaker Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as president and CEO with immediate effect. He had resigned on 12 November amid a personal controversy linked to an alleged espionage case. Colette Kress, who was interim CEO, continues as Chief Financial Officer. US investigations by the SEC and the Department of Justice are still under way, and Huang is due to testify before a US Senate committee on chip export controls on 3 December.
ai.gk: Nvidia, co-founded by Jensen Huang in 1993, makes the GPUs (graphics processing units) that power most AI training. India's IndiaAI Mission (2024) is building a shared compute facility of thousands of GPUs.
ai.exam: Remember: Nvidia CEO – Jensen Huang (reinstated 23 Nov 2026); CFO – Colette Kress. GPU = Graphics Processing Unit.

quiz.q: Who was reinstated as CEO of Nvidia on 23 November 2026?
quiz.explain: Nvidia's board reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang; Colette Kress returns to CFO.

aqi.asOf: CPCB real-time readings at 7 am on Monday, 23 Nov 2026 (as reported by Business Standard). The 4 pm 24-hour bulletins for 23 Nov were not found.
aqi.note: Air stayed 'poor' across most of NCR on Monday morning, a little worse than Sunday. Ghaziabad read 233 and Greater Noida 228; Faridabad was 'moderate' at 136. In Delhi, 51 of 58 stations were above 200 and five above 300, led by Sirifort (331) and NSUT Jaffarpur (323). By 8 am Delhi's average was 236. Forecasts say 'poor' till Wednesday, then 'poor' to 'very poor'. GRAP Stage II is in force across Delhi-NCR (Stage III was lifted on 17 Nov).
